records.text: Jerri Frantzve was awarded a gender research center at Radford University in 1983
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Back to Dr. Jerri (Jerri Frantzve), she is then somehow awarded an entire clinic, research center, pardon me, at Radford University in 1983, a gender clinic of all things.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Radford's Center for Gender Studies history says organizing began in 1989-90, lists Jerri among participating faculty, and identifies Hilary Lips—not Jerri—as director; this contradicts a 1983 award/directorship.

sources.title: History of the Center for Gender Studies at Radford University
sources.relevance: Center history dates formation to 1989-90, lists Jerri as faculty, and names Hilary Lips as director.

records.text: Jerri Frantzve’s gender clinic provided lessons to the military
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: She's a feminist and she's awarded a gender clinic. And they begin giving lessons to the military. My question is on what?

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. No reliable military or institutional source located established that Radford gender-clinic lessons were transferred to the military.
